episodes.title: Nicola Tallant on Daniel Kinahan's Return to Ireland and What's Next
episodes.description:
Crime journalist and Crime World host Nicola Tallant joins us following Daniel Kinahan's return to Ireland to face charges relating to directing the activities of a criminal organisation.

Nicola discusses what the charges mean, the possible evidence that may be presented in court, Daniel Kinahan's recent podcast appearances, and the future of the Kinahan cartel. She also talks about bringing Crime World to Electric Picnic and upcoming projects including The Witness and Dublin to Dubai.

episodes.title: The Hidden Reality of Multi-Level Marketing, The Truth About the 'Hey Hun' Business Model
episodes.description:
Multi-level marketing companies, or MLMs, are once again making headlines, with influencers and reality TV stars promoting business opportunities online.

Marketing Lecturer Dr Máire O'Sullivan and former MLM earner and author Emily Lynn Paulson explain how MLMs work, who they're targeting, why so many people are drawn in, and how they differ from illegal pyramid schemes.

Emily also shares her own experience of joining an MLM as a stay-at-home mum, becoming one of the company's success stories, and the moment she realised the reality didn't match the dream being sold.
